title: Pen tool & subselection (Bézier paths)
description: Pen tool (P): click to add anchor points, drag for handles, close path. Add Anchor (=), Delete Anchor (-), Convert Anchor (C) sub-tools. Subselection tool (A): drag to select anchor points, drag handles to reshape curves. Uses existing quadratic Bézier CurveSegment in engine. See docs/04-toolbox.md §Pen.
